def process(humanCausedAcres, suppressionCosts) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    # --- Human-caused acres: compute US total as sum across regions (exclude Year and any existing total column) ---
    h = humanCausedAcres.copy()
    h.columns = [c.strip() for c in h.columns]

    # Year
    h['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(h['Year'].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce')

    # Identify numeric candidate columns: everything except Year
    region_cols = [c for c in h.columns if c != 'Year']

    def to_number_series(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        return pd.to_numeric(
            s.astype(str)
             .str.strip()
             .replace({'N/A': np.nan, 'NA': np.nan, '': np.nan, 'nan': np.nan}),
            errors='coerce'
        )

    # Convert, removing thousands separators
    for c in region_cols:
        h[c] = to_number_series(h[c].str.replace(',', '', regex=False))

    # If there is a precomputed total column, prefer it; else sum regions
    total_candidates = [c for c in region_cols if c.lower() in {'total', 'us total', 'u.s. total', 'grand total'}]
    if len(total_candidates) > 0:
        total_col = total_candidates[0]
        h['humanAcres'] = h[total_col]
    else:
        h['humanAcres'] = h[region_cols].sum(axis=1, skipna=True)

    h = h[['Year', 'humanAcres']].dropna(subset=['Year']).groupby('Year', as_index=False).agg(humanAcres=('humanAcres', 'sum'))

    # --- Suppression costs: use Total column ---
    s = suppressionCosts.copy()
    s.columns = [c.strip() for c in s.columns]
    s['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(s['Year'].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce')

    # Total suppression cost column
    if 'Total' not in s.columns:
        # fallback: try case-insensitive match
        total_match = [c for c in s.columns if c.strip().lower() == 'total']
        if total_match:
            s.rename(columns={total_match[0]: 'Total'}, inplace=True)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Could not find 'Total' column in suppressionCosts. Columns: {list(s.columns)}")

    s['suppressionCost'] = pd.to_numeric(
        s['Total'].astype(str)
              .str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
              .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
              .str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )

    s = s[['Year', 'suppressionCost']].dropna(subset=['Year']).groupby('Year', as_index=False).agg(suppressionCost=('suppressionCost', 'sum'))

    # --- Join + compute cost per acre ---
    merged = s.merge(h, on='Year', how='inner')
    merged = merged[(merged['humanAcres'] > 0) & (merged['suppressionCost'].notna())]
    merged['costPerAcre'] = merged['suppressionCost'] / merged['humanAcres']

    # Select max costPerAcre year
    out = merged.sort_values('costPerAcre', ascending=False).head(1).copy()
    out['costPerAcreRounded1dp'] = out['costPerAcre'].round(1)
    return out[['Year', 'costPerAcre', 'costPerAcreRounded1dp', 'suppressionCost', 'humanAcres']]

operators.customDisplayName: Clean/parse human-caused acres and suppression costs (both loaded as tab-delimited strings); convert Year to numeric; for human-caused acres remove commas, map N/A to null, then compute US humanAcres as sum across all non-Year columns (unless a Total/US Total column exists); for suppression costs parse Total by stripping $ and commas to numeric suppressionCost; inner-join on Year; compute costPerAcre = suppressionCost/humanAcres; return the single year with maximum costPerAcre plus rounded-to-1dp value
